evals.prompt: Squad: Reporting a bug for investigation and GitHub tracking: Whenever the API pod restarts, runs that were in the 'awaiting_confirmation' state become permanently stuck. The user sees 'This run was interrupted and can no longer be confirmed. Please start a new task.' This is unacceptable UX — the run should be resumable since MAF serializes everything to disk. Run: https://agentweaver.example.io/projects/abc123/orchestrations/run-xyz
evals.expected_output: A filed GitHub issue with type:bug label, squad:smith + squad:morpheus assigned (MAF/runtime domain), go:yes, priority:p1, well-structured body with summary/run URL/expected/actual sections, and a dispatch block telling Smith to RCA and Morpheus to fix.
